verdict.rationale: Goodwin publishes a dedicated Founders Workbench financing guide explaining SAFEs vs. convertible notes, plus a broader venture capital practice representing 1,200+ emerging companies and entrepreneurs, showing a stated early-stage financing practice. Missing for 10: no dedicated seed-round case studies or explicit convertible note forms/templates beyond the SAFE explainer, and no independent third-party corroboration of the practice's depth.
